meta_description: Star pattern terracotta jali built from triangles and hexagons, in the Islamic geometric tradition. For screens and feature walls. Free sample.
description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 016 are a star pattern terracotta jali: the product photo shows triangle and hexagon shapes that combine into a star pattern, suited to feature walls, entrance screens and courtyards where a geometric, traditional look is wanted.

## How it looks
The triangles meet around hexagons so stars appear across the whole screen, a layout rooted in the Islamic geometric patterns seen in Mughal monuments. Because the design repeats in every direction, it holds together on a large wall and still looks detailed up close. The clay colour keeps the geometry warm rather than hard.

## Where it works
- **Star jali screen** at a main entrance or porch to frame the doorway.
- **Geometric islamic jali** in a mosque, prayer room or courtyard wall.
- **Hexagon jali design** as a feature panel in a garden or rooftop terrace.

Terracotta has been used for screens across the region for centuries, and fired clay generally weathers well outdoors in Pakistan, which suits an exposed decorative wall.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: triangle and hexagon shapes forming a star pattern (from the product photo)
- Material colour, block size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

Lay out a dry row before fixing so the stars line up across joints and at the wall ends. Clean the openings with a soft brush; avoid acid cleaners on clay.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall size for a dated quote. Read about [decorative and star tile designs](/blog/decorative-tiles-in-pakistan-handmade-patterned-and-star-designs), the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), or browse the [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of star pattern terracotta jali?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is a star pattern jali suitable for a mosque or prayer room?
faqs.a: It is a common choice, since star and hexagon geometry comes from the Islamic pattern tradition. It works as a screen, a window or a wall panel.

faqs.q: Star pattern jali or plain square jali: which is better?
faqs.a: A star pattern gives a traditional, decorative look and more visual detail; a plain square grid looks more modern and usually lets more air through.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
